newsitem.title: USA: Tyco files $900 mln stock, debt shelf.
newsitem.headline: Tyco files $900 mln stock, debt shelf.

text.p: Tyco International Ltd filed a shelf registration Thursday with the Securites and Exchange Commission to sell up to $900 million in common stock and debt securities.
Net proceeds will be used to refinance, in part, existing debt, to finance, in part, the cost of acquisitions, and for general corporate purposes, the filing said.
Tyco International, based in Exeter, Mass., manfactures and distributes disposable medical supplies and other specialty products.
The company also designs, manufactures, installs and services fire detection and suppression systems and manufactures and distributes flow control products and electrical and electronic components.
